jobs.title: Elite GHL Website Builder — Home Services (Design + Full Build)
jobs.description:
We're a home-services marketing company building a reusable GoHighLevel site template we'll clone across our client base. This isn't a from-scratch job — we already have the components, reference builds, and written instructions. You'll hybridize them into one polished template and build it fully live in GHL.

This is a design-and-build role, not SEO. Build with clean semantic structure (one H1, proper H2s, sectioned rows) so our SEO specialist can layer the technical work on afterward.

Hard rules — read before applying:

1. Native GHL elements only. Absolutely no custom CSS. We will not maintain per-client CSS. If your builds depend on custom CSS, we're not a fit.
2. Need specific images or branding assets during the build? Request them and we'll provide.
3. Due Sunday.

You must be:

A master of the native GHL website/funnel builder — working entirely within its elements

A real designer: layout, spacing, typography, hierarchy. If it looks cheap, we're out.

Able to get the best possible mobile speed out of GHL

Ideally proven on home-services / contractor sites

To apply:

Send the single best website you have ever built. One link. Preferably home services.

More than one link = auto-disqualified. We want your one best, not a portfolio. If that one site isn't excellent, we don't move forward — the bar is the ceiling of your skill.

Hourly. Tell us your rate.
jobs.ai_reason: The budget is relatively low for a design-and-build project, but the client provides clear instructions and existing components, which could simplify the work.
